Moss's 30 September strategic digest gives Mateo's Door 14 ticket as **#8841**. I replied to you in our DM with the same answer.

The digest describes it as the Vantorre Group ticket about drivers at the Newark facility being unable to select Dock Door 14 on the check-in kiosk. It says you escalated it to platform engineering.

I'd confirm the number in the ticketing system before it goes into the engineering follow-up. On 1 July you posted in #strategic-pod that you'd closed #8841, which was the Detention Summary CSV and kiosk cache issue, a different problem. The number may have been reused by mistake in the digest. I couldn't find another Door 14 ticket number in the channels, files or mail you can see.
